book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Roḡae Modeꞌeteꞌe moneo Ihoziro
Iesuꞌa eꞌe ḡoeꞌa hauḡirotene Galilea habaꞌa modadu Ioridana vuḡa moneafa Iudea habaꞌa onamiro.
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ani hegotiro ebu aniꞌa eꞌea ugi azaḡa faiziro.
Farisea azaḡa nuꞌa Iesu tuhune nurifine ani vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Ohoze ꞌahoganiꞌa inuga mazao mene matuꞌine, inuga modogaꞌe idaḡahe?”
Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Za Buka Zaḡoḡa mene meꞌodirohe? Ḡadaheḡano Badiꞌaꞌa vaze haḡairotene, ohoze zu roḡae haḡairo.
Ebu Badiꞌaꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Eꞌanoꞌo ohozeꞌe viꞌa moga modadu inuga teite tiburaꞌuma ebu anianine ahiri tiba reꞌuma.'
Eꞌe uꞌano, zeꞌe mene aheu, rehano ahiri tiba. Eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa tibuzirotaꞌaꞌe vazeꞌa mene rovoniꞌuma.”
Zeꞌa ḡadiniro, “ꞌOugine, nougadu Moseꞌa ḡoere riḡa ꞌadi ziro, 'Ohozeꞌa inuga modoꞌidene, ihore soꞌaḡa mirihadu inuga hanoꞌi ebu ani modoꞌi.'”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Zamaze riḡa ꞌahine, Moseꞌa inudeze modogaꞌe idaḡa rae reiro. Rehano ḡadaheḡanoꞌe mene idararo.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa inugaꞌe mene ubuma ḡezaro rehano, inuga modadu roḡae ꞌahoga teite hahurine, aniꞌe ubuma ḡezauꞌohe.”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Iesu niro, “ꞌAhiguḡaniꞌa iꞌa inuga mazao fureraune, guruvorau radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe ufeta manoḡa.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Vaze niduꞌa ḡoere ꞌahi mae ḡihinogaꞌe mene idaḡa. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa danazeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa daꞌo idaḡa.

Vaze nuꞌe fureraroteꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo ahiri ugiḡeta radu mene hahureꞌohe. Nuꞌe vazeꞌa ahiri ariro. Nuꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌazoga veize gauihi radu zeḡeꞌa bare mene hahuriro. Iniuꞌa ꞌahi ḡoeꞌa mae ḡihinoga idaḡa roꞌidene, mae ḡihinoꞌi.”
Tahiꞌa Komeꞌakomeꞌa ebu Iesu
Eꞌe madaḡano vaze nuꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa tutuze Iesu vaḡe ariro, mazaḡa aniꞌa ze rana ꞌevoꞌa teadu kuranoga uratiro. Rehano ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa tutuze ariroteꞌe azaḡa roziro.
ꞌOugirotene, Iesuꞌa ziro, “Tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa eḡe vaḡe tuḡuzoꞌi zu ze ago gararoꞌi. Mazaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa teigeꞌeteꞌe azaḡa.”
Ebu aniꞌa zeḡe rana ꞌevoꞌa teadu kuraroteꞌe ḡarugano eꞌea iḡune onamiro.
Maꞌora Vazeḡa
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, e nagi manoḡa haḡaine, ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡaꞌe nougadu eḡe mazao naginiꞌe manoḡa rae ḡadimuꞌohe? Manoḡaꞌe Badiꞌa tibuhuga daꞌo. Ḡaꞌa ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidihi roꞌidene, Badiꞌa goro ḡoeꞌa hegotoꞌi.”
Vaze eꞌeꞌa ḡadiniro, “Noꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa hegotiꞌuma?” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “'Vaze ago gorunoꞌi, ubuma ago ḡezanoꞌi, ago ḡonotanoꞌi, vaze moneo ago ḡuriroꞌi,
viꞌu mogo gubazoꞌi ebu ḡaeꞌa bare zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige nabugo zuni zamare borofoꞌi.'”
Tahiꞌa iziganiꞌa niro, “E goro ḡoeꞌa eꞌe niduꞌa hegote ariro. Hena nagini bare haḡaiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao veꞌoḡa oꞌoꞌa reihi roꞌidene, onamadu ḡauḡo niduꞌa seronoꞌi ebu zahara azaḡa zenoꞌi. ꞌOugine, ḡa adureo ḡau naeḡa boroboro hidiꞌuma. Ebu aradu eḡe hegotoꞌi.”
Tahiꞌa iziganiꞌa Iesu ḡoere igirotene, zamaḡaniꞌa adudu bororuꞌenaꞌa iḡuniro, mazaḡa aniꞌe ufeta maꞌora vazeḡa.
Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, maꞌora vazeḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa rougaꞌe riḡa bagaḡa.
Eḡeꞌa bare ziꞌohe, kameroꞌa niduru hoꞌoga diuḡogaꞌe riḡa. Rehano maꞌora vazeḡaniꞌa Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano rougaꞌe ufeta riḡa.”
Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa eꞌe igirotene, zaguzagau rudaro ebu ḡadiniro, “ꞌOugine, iniuꞌa ḡabone hidiꞌuma?”
Iesuꞌa ḡiazadu ziro, “Vaze aneꞌa bare ḡabone hidogaꞌe mene idaḡa, rehano Badiꞌaꞌe ḡau niduꞌa haḡaoga idaḡa.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa niro, “Eme emeḡe ḡau niduꞌa modadu ḡa hegotiro. ꞌOugadu emeꞌe nagini hidiꞌuma?”

Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe. Raha ꞌahi niduꞌaꞌe bare izidatiteꞌe madaḡano Vaze Ubuganiꞌa kini ehoro habaꞌa ḡihiꞌaḡa hune rana ehorine, eḡe hegotiroteꞌe azaḡa, zae zuni kini ehoro habaꞌa gaubanana aheu fare rana ehoradu Isaraela azaḡa, urabo niduꞌa gaubanana aheu fare kotaziꞌuma.
Ebu iniuꞌa eḡe uꞌano neḡa, negoḡa, ezeḡa, viꞌa, moga, tahiꞌaḡa ga ane haba modine, aniꞌe naeḡa ḡae 100 hidiꞌuma ebu Moga mazaonoꞌo ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma.
Rehano vaze ibiꞌa ḡehaḡaꞌe ḡonaga reꞌuma, u vaze ḡonaga ḡehaḡaꞌe ibiꞌa reꞌuma.”
